title: Artis, zeeleeuwen - SoundCloud - Beeld en Geluid
author: Beeld en Geluid
changes: California sea lion barking (an eared seal, the classic barking seal) at Artis zoo, Amsterdam. Trimmed to 12.35–14.60 s of the original, mixed to mono, gentle 12 dB/oct high-pass at 70 Hz, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3.
